steps.eval: restoreSession('sess_night_1104_t01')

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); const names = cards.map(c => (c.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim()); return names.includes('告警等级分布') && names.includes('告警区域分布') && !names.includes('告警列表'); })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); const names = cards.map(c => (c.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim()); return names.includes('能耗趋势分析') && names.includes('总耗电概览'); })()

(() => { const pick = (n) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).find(el => (el.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim() === n); const sectors = (card) => { if (window.echarts && typeof window.echarts.getInstanceByDom === 'function') { for (const d of Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('div')).filter(x => x.querySelector('canvas'))) { const inst = window.echarts.getInstanceByDom(d); const opt = inst && inst.getOption && inst.getOption(); const s = opt && opt.series && opt.series[0]; if (s && String(s.type) === 'pie') return true; } } return Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('svg path')).some(p => /A\s/.test(p.getAttribute('d') || '')); }; const l = pick('告警等级分布'), a = pick('告警区域分布'); return !!l && !!a && sectors(l) && sectors(a); })()

(() => { if (!(window.echarts && typeof window.echarts.getInstanceByDom === 'function')) return 'svg-fallback'; const pick = (n) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).find(el => (el.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim() === n); for (const n of ['告警等级分布','告警区域分布']) { const card = pick(n); for (const d of Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('div')).filter(x => x.querySelector('canvas'))) { const inst = window.echarts.getInstanceByDom(d); const opt = inst && inst.getOption && inst.getOption(); const s = opt && opt.series && opt.series[0]; if (s && String(s.type) === 'pie') return 'echarts-pie'; } } return 'none'; })()

(() => { if (!(window.echarts && typeof window.echarts.getInstanceByDom === 'function')) return false; const pick = (n) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).find(el => (el.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim() === n); const dataOf = (card) => { for (const d of Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('div')).filter(x => x.querySelector('canvas'))) { const inst = window.echarts.getInstanceByDom(d); const opt = inst && inst.getOption && inst.getOption(); const s = opt && opt.series && opt.series[0]; if (s && String(s.type) === 'pie') return s.data || []; } return null; }; const l = dataOf(pick('告警等级分布')); const a = dataOf(pick('告警区域分布')); if (!l || !a) return false; const names = (d) => d.map(x => String(x.name)); const values = (d) => d.map(x => Number(x.value)); if (names(l).join(',') !== '严重,重要,一般,提示') return false; if (names(a).join(',') !== '华北机房,华东机房,华南机房,西部机房') return false; if (names(l).length !== values(l).length || names(a).length !== values(a).length) return false; if (values(l).some(v => !Number.isFinite(v) || v <= 0)) return false; if (values(a).some(v => !Number.isFinite(v) || v <= 0)) return false; return true; })()

(() => { const notes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-chart-simulated="true"]')); if (notes.length < 2) return false; return notes.every(n => (n.textContent || '').includes('模拟')); })()
(() => { const notes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-chart-unit="条"]')); return notes.length >= 2; })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); const names = Array.from(new Set(cards.map(c => (c.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim()))); return names.filter(n => n === '告警等级分布' || n === '告警区域分布').length === 2 && names.includes('能耗趋势分析') && names.includes('总耗电概览') && !names.includes('告警列表'); })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); return Array.from(new Set(cards.map(c => (c.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim()))).join('|'); })()

(() => { const pane = document.getElementById('draft-pane'); if (!pane) return false; const cards = Array.from(pane.querySelectorAll('[data-region-id]')).filter(el => el.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0 && el.offsetParent !== null); const card = cards.find(el => (el.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim() === '告警等级分布'); if (!card) return false; pane.scrollTop = pane.scrollTop + card.getBoundingClientRect().top - pane.getBoundingClientRect().top - 24; return pane.scrollTop > 0; })()

(() => { const pane = document.getElementById('draft-pane'); if (!pane) return false; const cards = Array.from(pane.querySelectorAll('[data-region-id]'))   .filter(el => el.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0 && el.offsetParent !== null); const keep = new Set(['告警等级分布', '告警区域分布']); let hidden = 0; for (const el of cards) { const n = (el.querySelector('.region-name')?.textContent || '').trim();   if (!keep.has(n)) { el.style.display = 'none'; hidden += 1; } } return hidden >= 1; })()
